notes.zh:
- 录屏区域可跟随鼠标移动，更方便演示操作。
- 文字识别与翻译更好地保留原文颜色、段落和排版。
- 新增在线账户与积分管理，方便查看账户和用量。
- 改善截图、菜单和自动更新的稳定性；修复 macOS 滚动截图快捷键与窗口遮挡问题。
notes.en:
- Let the recording area follow your mouse for easier demonstrations.
- Text recognition and translation better preserve original colors, paragraphs, and layout.
- Manage your online account and credits, and check your usage in the app.
- Improved screenshot, menu, and update reliability; fixed macOS scrolling-capture shortcuts and windows covering captures.

notes.zh:
- 高分屏截图可选择输出尺寸，让图片更适合分享与查看。
- 支持在图片编辑器中粘贴剪贴板内容，并将剪贴板公式渲染为贴图。
- 绘图工具可同步新建标注的颜色；荧光笔支持自定义预设颜色。
- 序号工具的光标可预览即将添加的数字。
- 改善启动、自动更新、截图导出和存储的稳定性。
notes.en:
- Choose the output size of HiDPI screenshots for easier sharing and viewing.
- Paste clipboard content into the image editor and pin clipboard formulas as rendered images.
- Keep new annotation colors in sync across drawing tools and customize highlight color presets.
- Preview the next number in the serial-number tool's cursor.
- Improved reliability when starting the app, updating, exporting screenshots, and saving data.

notes.zh:
- 可将系统中选中的图片直接导入编辑器；拼图预览更清晰，PDF 排版更灵活。
- 浮动工具栏可按需添加截图历史、全屏画布和图片编辑等快捷入口。
- 截图历史浏览更流畅、占用更少；更新后自动清理安装缓存。
- 支持一键导出日志和崩溃报告，方便反馈问题。
- 改善全屏截图、贴图标注和录屏工具栏的稳定性。
notes.en:
- Open selected images directly in the editor, with clearer collage previews and more flexible PDF layouts.
- Add screenshot history, full-screen canvas, and image editing shortcuts to your floating toolbar.
- Browse screenshot history more smoothly with less storage use; update files are cleaned up after installation.
- Export logs and crash reports together for easier troubleshooting.
- Improved full-screen capture, pinned annotations, and recording toolbar reliability.

notes.zh:
- 新增“贴图后保留标注可编辑”设置，贴图后仍可修改标注、撤销和重做。
- 贴图文字工具栏新增复制按钮，选中文字即可复制。
- 恢复的贴图会应用当前设置；重新编辑历史截图时避免重复叠加旧标注。
- 改善编号标注删除后的排序、长图拆分预览和 Windows 截图稳定性。
notes.en:
- Enable “Keep annotations editable after pinning to screen” to edit, undo, and redo annotations on pinned images.
- Copy selected text directly from the pinned-text toolbar.
- Restored pinned images follow your current settings; reopening history images avoids duplicate annotations.
- Improved numbered annotations after deletion, long-image split previews, and Windows capture reliability.

notes.zh:
- 长图智能拆分，自动寻找合适的切分位置，并可调整分块重叠范围。
- 支持打开和导出 TIFF 图片；拼图时可移动图片、调整大小。
- 支持快捷键启动滚动截图，可在设置中配置 HTTP 代理。
- 修复滚动截图编辑后无法复制的问题，改善 macOS 开机启动设置的响应速度。
- 改善贴图边框、工具栏操作和无障碍支持，缩小 Windows 安装包。
notes.en:
- Split long images at natural breaks and adjust the overlap between pieces.
- Open and export TIFF images; move and resize images in collages.
- Start scrolling screenshots with a keyboard shortcut and set an HTTP proxy in settings.
- Fixed copying after editing scrolling screenshots and improved macOS launch-at-login responsiveness.
- Improved pinned-image borders, toolbar behavior, and accessibility; reduced Windows installer sizes.

notes.zh:
- Fixed screenshots sometimes failing to save to history.
- Made translated text more stable as results appear, reducing shifting and overlap.
- Start a new annotation immediately when clicking to clear the previous selection.
notes.en:
- Fixed screenshots sometimes failing to save to history.
- Made translated text more stable as results appear, reducing shifting and overlap.
- Start a new annotation immediately when clicking to clear the previous selection.

notes.zh:
- 截图选区支持快速添加文字标注，历史记录支持复制图片路径。
- 表格识别支持实时预览与纠错，LaTeX 识别结果可边识别边预览。
- 新增免费翻译，支持快速切换翻译服务，并改善译文字号保留。
- 贴图支持批量复制和拼图，摇动贴图可显示或隐藏其他贴图，导出时保留最新编辑。
- 录屏按键显示可分别控制数字、字母与符号、控制键和快捷键。
- 缩小部分安装包、降低导出内存占用，修复 macOS 焦点与图片拖放、工具栏越界及截图编辑问题。
notes.en:
- 截图选区支持快速添加文字标注，历史记录支持复制图片路径。
- 表格识别支持实时预览与纠错，LaTeX 识别结果可边识别边预览。
- 新增免费翻译，支持快速切换翻译服务，并改善译文字号保留。
- 贴图支持批量复制和拼图，摇动贴图可显示或隐藏其他贴图，导出时保留最新编辑。
- 录屏按键显示可分别控制数字、字母与符号、控制键和快捷键。
- 缩小部分安装包、降低导出内存占用，修复 macOS 焦点与图片拖放、工具栏越界及截图编辑问题。

notes.zh:
- PDF 拼图新增多图与证件模板，支持调整图片间距、反转页面顺序。
- 智能选择可选窗口、窗口子元素或关闭，并可配置取消截图操作。
- 可选择在全屏游戏或所有全屏窗口中自动停用全局快捷键。
- 贴图支持使用标准粘贴快捷键替换内容，恢复后保留原有叠放顺序。
- 改善截图恢复、macOS 开机启动和工具提示，导入设置时保留本机目录。
notes.en:
- Create PDFs with image and ID-card templates, adjust image spacing, and reverse page order.
- Choose smart selection for windows or window elements, or turn it off; add a cancel action to your screenshot controls.
- Automatically pause global hotkeys for fullscreen games or all fullscreen windows.
- Replace pinned content with standard paste shortcuts and keep pins in the same stacking order after restoring them.
- Improve capture recovery, macOS launch at login, tooltip timing, and settings transfers that preserve your local folders.

notes.zh:
- 支持窗口实时贴图，现已覆盖 macOS，并可批量管理贴图。
- 贴图支持裁剪，编辑后的图片可直接贴图，摇一摇可隐藏其他贴图。
- 新增支持吸附的括号标注及更多距离单位。
- 可配置 Windows 文件资源管理器菜单，直接打开图片进行标注。
- 翻译新增印地语、泰语和越南语，优化工具提示、截图、录屏控制及更新体验。
notes.en:
- Pin a live view of a window, now also on macOS, and manage multiple pinned images together.
- Crop pinned images, pin images after editing, and hide other pins with a shake.
- Add bracket annotations with snapping and measure with more distance units.
- Open images for annotation from configurable Windows File Explorer menus.
- Translate into Hindi, Thai, and Vietnamese; enjoy clearer tooltips and more reliable capture, recording controls, and updates.

notes.zh:
- 文字识别更快，文字高亮更流畅，并支持可选 GPU 加速。
- macOS 支持通过隔空投送分享截图，菜单栏图标可跟随系统颜色。
- 裁剪新增边界辅助线，修复 macOS 编辑工具栏被预览遮挡的问题。
- 历史记录记住每页数量，滚动时仍可使用选择操作栏。
- 改善 HDR 显示器截图兼容性，提升录屏工具栏稳定性。
- 便携版默认关闭系统集成。
notes.en:
- Faster text recognition, smoother text highlighting, and optional GPU acceleration.
- Share screenshots with AirDrop on macOS and choose a menu bar icon that follows system colors.
- Crop images more precisely with boundary guides; the macOS editing toolbar stays above the preview.
- History remembers your preferred page size and keeps selection controls visible while scrolling.
- More reliable capture on HDR displays and a more stable recording toolbar.
- Portable builds leave system integrations disabled by default.

notes.zh:
- 气泡标注支持更多样式，箭头可添加描边。
- 可设置双击或中键识别文字，或识别后直接复制。
- 托盘点击操作可设置为“无”。
- 修复录屏中鼠标指针的颜色偏差。
- 自动清理已完成的更新文件，释放磁盘空间。
notes.en:
- Style speech bubbles and add outlines to arrows.
- Recognize text or copy it directly with your configured double-click or middle-click action.
- Disable tray-click actions when you do not need them.
- Keep recorded cursor colors accurate.
- Free disk space by cleaning up completed update files.

notes.zh:
- 新增云朵形思考气泡标注。
- 统一主键盘与数字键盘 Enter 快捷键行为。
- 改善大图导入、编辑、拼图及分割的稳定性。
- 即使扩展名缺失或错误，也能正确识别导入的图片。
- 修复选区边框干扰取色结果的问题。
- 绘图资源按需加载，减少启动时的内存占用。
notes.en:
- Add cloud-shaped thought bubbles to your screenshots.
- Use Enter and numeric-keypad Enter consistently with your shortcuts.
- Open large images more reliably for editing, stitching, and splitting.
- Recognize imported images correctly even when their file extension is missing or incorrect.
- Pick accurate image colors without selection outlines affecting the result.
- Reduce startup memory use by loading drawing resources when needed.

notes.zh:
- 支持自动选中新建标注，并按绘图工具设置例外。
- 支持在图片上直接编辑测距标注。
- 修复导出的 Excel 文件可能无法正常打开的问题。
- 改善 macOS 麦克风启动稳定性及错误提示。
notes.en:
- Select new annotations automatically and choose which drawing tools use this behavior.
- Edit distance labels directly on the image.
- Fix Excel exports that could fail to open correctly.
- Improve macOS microphone startup reliability and error reporting.

notes.zh:
- 录屏摄像头支持旋转、翻转，导出视频保持一致。
- 支持通过自定义快捷键复用最近录屏区域。
- 修复识别结果选中文字复制，保持粘贴 HTML 图片的原始宽度。
- 改善 macOS 截图、贴图稳定性及 WinGet 安装可靠性。
notes.en:
- Rotate or flip your webcam while recording, with the same orientation in the saved video.
- Reuse recent recording areas with customizable shortcuts.
- Copy selected OCR text correctly and preserve the original width of pasted HTML images.
- Improve macOS screenshot and pinned-window stability, plus WinGet installation reliability.

notes.zh:
- 支持批量处理截图、排队导出，并可在保存完成后复制文件、复制路径或打开所在文件夹。
- 识别的表格可直接在表格软件中打开；改善复制、导出的格式和默认字体。
- 录屏支持显示鼠标滚轮操作，演示过程更清晰。
- 可自定义选区边框效果；全局画布工具栏在鼠标移开后淡出；截图历史和贴图管理更方便。
- 修复 macOS 屏幕安全区域变化时的标注错位。
notes.en:
- **Faster screenshot workflows:** apply actions to multiple captures, queue exports, and copy the saved file or its path or open its folder from the save result.
- **Tables that paste correctly (Full):** open recognized tables in your spreadsheet app, with more reliable formatting and default fonts when copying or exporting.
- **Clearer recordings:** show mouse-wheel scrolling alongside keyboard and mouse effects.
- **More comfortable capture and annotation:** customize selection-border effects, let the global canvas toolbar fade when the pointer moves away, and manage history and pinned images more easily.
- **Better macOS alignment:** annotations stay aligned when the screen's safe area changes.

notes.zh:
- **录屏摄像头布局可调整**：直接移动、缩放摄像头画面，自由安排录屏布局。
- **演示和标注更顺手**：新增全局激光笔；可设置文字删除方向，翻转图标也更清晰。
- **翻译更方便（完整版）**：支持 DeepLX，可将翻译结果复制为图片；记住独立翻译窗口的位置和大小，并在临时限流后自动重试。
- **AI 模型配置更准确（完整版）**：可按 OpenAI、通义千问、DeepSeek、豆包分别配置推理能力。
- **复制与截图更可靠**：复制截图时同时提供导出文件，方便粘贴到文件管理器；修复弹窗阻挡截图、多屏十字光标、贴图位置恢复和透明背景效果问题。
notes.en:
- **Adjustable webcam layout:** move and resize the webcam overlay to arrange your recording.
- **Better presentation and annotation:** use the new global laser pointer, choose the text deletion direction, and find flip actions more easily with clearer icons.
- **Easier translation (Full):** connect DeepLX, copy translation results as images, restore the translation window's size and position, and retry automatically after temporary rate limits.
- **Provider-aware AI settings (Full):** configure reasoning support for OpenAI, Qwen, DeepSeek, and Doubao.
- **More reliable capture and copying:** copied screenshots also include an exported file for pasting into file managers. Fixes cover popups blocking capture, crosshairs on multiple displays, restored pinned-image positions, and effects on transparent backgrounds.

notes.zh:
- **录屏预览更方便**：裁剪预览支持播放和暂停，动态效果预览可显示录制状态提示。
- **录屏和截图更流畅**：优化 Windows 与 macOS 的采集、画面合成和视频导出，改善截图复制与保存的响应速度。
- **贴图识别更顺手**：可将双击或鼠标中键设为显示、隐藏文字识别结果。
- **修复编辑与 AI 配置问题**：图片编辑的效果预览正确保留背景；升级后更可靠地恢复旧版 AI 模型选择。
- **Windows 集成更完善**：可在应用设置中配置打包版的“使用 Snow Shot 编辑”右键菜单；安装目录统一提供第三方许可说明。
notes.en:
- **Better recording previews:** play or pause while previewing a trimmed recording, and show recording status in the motion-effects preview.
- **Smoother recording and capture:** improved capture, compositing, and video export on Windows and macOS, plus more responsive screenshot copying and saving.
- **Quicker pinned-image OCR:** assign double-click or middle-click to show or hide recognized text.
- **Editing and AI fixes:** effect previews preserve the image background, and upgrades restore legacy AI model selections more reliably.
- **Windows integration:** configure the packaged app's “Edit with Snow Shot” context menu in settings; third-party license notices are consolidated in the installation folder.

notes.zh:
- **独立图片编辑器**：从截图历史或贴图打开图片继续编辑，支持标注、裁剪、撤销/重做、智能擦除和保存；优化大图编辑与识别的响应速度。
- **录屏支持摄像头**：将摄像头画面加入录屏，并在开始前预览叠加效果；改善 macOS 摄像头采集和提示显示。
- **硬件 H.265 录制**：新增 H.265（硬件）选项，在支持的设备上减少编码负担；优化录制与视频导出的帧处理。
- **历史与界面更方便**：从截图历史直接定位已保存文件，应用字号按像素设置；修复取色器拖动时的透明度、贴图拖动、聚光灯和形状文字控制柄问题。
- **更流畅、更稳定**：加快 ARM64 拼图，改善滚动截图与录屏资源使用，并修复 ARM64 图片渲染和 macOS 智能选区稳定性问题。
notes.en:
- **Standalone image editor:** reopen captures from history or pinned images to annotate, crop, undo/redo, erase unwanted content, and save. Large-image editing and recognition respond faster.
- **Webcam recording:** add your camera to screen recordings and preview overlays before capture. Improved camera capture and warning placement on macOS.
- **Hardware H.265:** choose H.265 (Hardware) to reduce encoding work on supported devices. Recording and video export also benefit from more efficient frame processing.
- **Convenient history and controls:** reveal saved captures in your file manager and set the app font size in pixels. Fixes cover color-picker opacity while dragging, pinned-window moves, spotlights, and shape text handles.
- **Smoother, more reliable operation:** faster ARM64 image stitching, lower overhead during scrolling capture and recording, and fixes for ARM64 image rendering and macOS smart selection.

notes.zh:
- **截图与标注更顺手**：多选区可独立吸附，智能选区动画速度可调；形状支持绑定文字标签，序号支持不同笔触风格。修复跨选区空隙的标注丢失和紧凑布局缩放问题。
- **贴图用途更丰富**：支持将文本、Markdown、HTML 和 CSS 文件贴到屏幕；颜色可显示为可交互色卡，滚轮缩放与透明度步长可自定义。
- **识别与保存更方便**：新增识别完成后自动复制文字的截图动作；更新本地 OCR 引擎，减少识别启动开销；保存路径支持时间变量。
- **录屏导出更精细**：减少静止内容的 GIF 文件体积，改进离线视频导出质量，以及裁剪后的画面、音频和时长一致性。
- **稳定性改进**：优化截图、贴图和图片处理的内存释放，修复弹出菜单悬停、颜色行显示和笔触样式问题。
notes.en:
- **Easier capture and annotation:** snap individual capture regions, adjust smart-selection animation speed, attach text labels to shapes, and apply stroke styles to numbered markers. Fixes preserve annotations across region gaps and image scale in compact layouts.
- **More useful pins:** pin text, Markdown, HTML, and CSS files; display colors as interactive swatches; customize mouse-wheel zoom and opacity steps.
- **Quicker recognition and saving:** choose a capture action that copies text after recognition. An updated local OCR engine reduces startup work, and save paths now support time variables.
- **Better recording exports:** smaller GIFs for scenes with static content, improved offline video quality, and more accurate trimmed pictures, audio, and duration.
- **Stability improvements:** better memory cleanup for captures, pinned content, and image processing, plus fixes for popup hovering, color rows, and stroke styles.

notes.zh:
- **一次截取多个区域**：在同一截图中选择、编辑多个区域；开启紧凑布局并调整间距，减少导出、复制、贴图和识别结果中的空白。
- **更自由的标注外观**：新增建筑师、艺术家、漫画家三种笔触风格；选区背景透明度可调，预设和历史记录会保留设置。
- **贴图操作更顺手**：一键将全部贴图收起到顶部；可设置关闭贴图时先退出标注，支持重置缩放和直接销毁的鼠标动作。
- **图片与多屏操作**：拼图和拆图支持粘贴图片，可拆分所选图片；截图时按 Ctrl+A 可扩展到全部屏幕，并可自定义 Windows 菜单访问键。
- **更轻巧、更稳定**：缩小发布包，提升 ARM64 图片处理和录屏性能；修复压感笔宽度、拼图 PDF 保存、录屏静音图标、窗口捕获排除与剪贴板解码问题。
notes.en:
- **Capture several regions at once:** select and edit multiple regions in one screenshot. Use compact layouts with adjustable spacing to reduce gaps in saved, copied, pinned, and recognized images.
- **Customize your annotations:** choose Architect, Artist, or Cartoonist stroke styles and adjust selection background opacity. Presets and capture history retain these settings.
- **Manage pinned images faster:** hide all pinned windows at the top, choose whether closing first exits annotation mode, and assign mouse actions to reset zoom or close a pin immediately.
- **Work with images and multiple displays:** paste images into collage and split workflows, split a selected image, expand capture to all screens with Ctrl+A, and customize the Windows menu access key.
- **Smaller and smoother:** smaller downloads and faster ARM64 image processing and recording, with fixes for pen pressure, collage PDF saving, muted recording icons, capture exclusions, and clipboard decoding.

notes.zh:
- **图片拆分与拼图**：按横向、纵向或网格切分图片并批量保存；拼图支持拖入图片、自定义网格，以及可调整分页与布局的多页 PDF 导出。
- **绘图与贴图**：自由画笔支持压感；文字贴图可自定义样式，图片导入新增 BMP 支持。
- **识别与翻译（完整版）**：识别的表格可导出为 Excel 工作簿；按检测到的输入语言自动选择翻译目标。
- **录屏与外观**：录屏工具栏支持自动隐藏，鼠标高亮半径可调；托盘图标可随明暗主题切换，视频编码默认使用 H.264。
- **更流畅、更稳定**：降低图片工作流的内存占用，优化拆分预览、撤销和导出；修复文件粘贴、十字光标显示、选区边缘操作和 macOS 弹窗显示问题。
notes.en:
- **Split images and build collages:** split horizontally, vertically, or into a grid and save the pieces together. Drag images into collages, customize grids, and export multi-page PDFs with adjustable page layouts.
- **Drawing and pinned images:** use pressure-sensitive freehand drawing, customize pinned text styles, and import BMP images.
- **Recognition and translation (Full):** export recognized tables as Excel workbooks and choose translation targets automatically from the detected input language.
- **Recording and appearance:** auto-hide the recording toolbar, adjust mouse highlight size, and use tray icons that follow light/dark themes. Video encoding now defaults to H.264.
- **Smoother everyday use:** reduced image-workflow memory use and faster split previews, undo, and export. Fixes improve file pasting, crosshair display, selection-edge interaction, and macOS dialogs.

notes.zh:
- **新增图片拼接**：从截图历史、贴图或选中的图片创建拼图，在编辑器中调整布局，然后复制或保存结果。
- **复用选区更方便**：浏览之前的选区，快速选回需要的区域；可在设置中配置上一选区、下一选区快捷键。
- **键盘截图更顺手**：默认按 Enter 复制截图；同时按住两个方向的移动快捷键可斜向移动光标。
- **日常修复**：改善 macOS 截图窗口关闭、贴图原图预览对齐、文字边缘显示和全屏快捷键行为；导出时提示文件名冲突。
notes.en:
- **Image stitching:** create a collage from screenshot history, pinned images, or selected image files. Adjust its layout, then copy or save the result.
- **Reuse selection areas:** browse previous areas and return to the one you need. Configure previous/next area shortcuts in Settings.
- **Easier keyboard capture:** Enter copies a screenshot by default. Hold movement shortcuts for two directions together to move the cursor diagonally.
- **Everyday fixes:** improved macOS screenshot closing, alignment of original-image previews, text edge rendering, and fullscreen shortcut handling. Export warns about filename conflicts.

notes.zh:
- **新增对话气泡标注**：在截图和画布上添加对话气泡，调整形状、边框、填充和圆角；可自定义快捷键，样式会记住你的选择。
- **识别文字选择更方便**：拖出矩形选取 OCR 文字，选择时实时预览；文字识别与贴图中的选取和渲染更流畅，按住 Alt 可在文字区域拖动贴图。
- **识别结果高亮可开关**：在设置中选择是否用遮罩突出显示识别文字。
- **日常操作更稳定**：修复全局快捷键释放问题、恢复选区预设后的工具栏布局；改善格式化文字贴图的默认字体和放大镜渐变连接的可见性。
notes.en:
- **Speech-bubble annotations:** add speech bubbles to screenshots and canvases, customize their shape, border, fill, and corners, and assign a shortcut. Your chosen style is remembered.
- **Easier OCR text selection:** drag a rectangle to select recognized text with a live preview. Text selection and rendering are smoother in recognition views and pinned images; hold Alt to drag a pin over its text.
- **Optional text highlighting:** choose whether recognition results are highlighted with a mask in Settings.
- **Everyday fixes:** more reliable global shortcuts, correctly fitted toolbars after restoring selection presets, a more readable default font for formatted text pins, and clearer magnifier gradient connections.

notes.zh:
- **放大细节与测量更方便**：新增可调节的截图放大镜，支持渐变连接与源区域描边；角度标注支持内角、共用边长和拖动圆弧半径。
- **选区与保存更顺手**：可保存选区预设、恢复上次选区，用滚轮从中心调整大小，并选择哪些截图操作触发自动保存；阴影颜色和标注样式会记住你的选择。
- **贴图支持动图**：GIF、APNG 和 WebP 动图可贴到屏幕；格式化文字贴图支持选中文字，工具栏定位和多显示器切换更稳定。
- **录屏编辑更灵活**：剪辑时可调整播放与导出速度，缩小录屏时保留更多细节，并可选择关闭后删除录屏。
- **图片打开更便捷（Windows）**：可启用图片右键菜单，直接用 Snow Shot 或 Mini 打开图片并贴到屏幕。
- **识别与长截图更好用**：识别预览支持缩放与自适应位置，复制 HTML 识别结果保留格式；改善 macOS 滚动截图、拼接速度、快捷键与窗口稳定性。高级识别功能仅适用于完整版。
notes.en:
- **Magnify and measure details:** adjustable screenshot magnifiers with gradient connections and source outlines; angle annotations support interior angles, shared side lengths, and draggable arc radii.
- **Faster selection and saving:** save selection presets, restore the previous selection, resize from the center with the mouse wheel, and choose which capture actions automatically save an image. Shadow colors and annotation styles remember your choices.
- **Animated pinned images:** pin GIF, APNG, and WebP animations to your screen; select text in formatted text pins, with more reliable toolbar placement and display changes.
- **More flexible recording edits:** change playback and export speed, preserve more detail when downscaling, and optionally delete a recording when closing it.
- **Open images from Explorer (Windows):** enable image context-menu entries to open and pin images with Snow Shot or Mini.
- **Better recognition and scrolling capture:** zoom and adaptive placement in recognition previews, formatted HTML copying, smoother macOS scrolling capture and faster stitching, plus shortcut and window reliability fixes. Advanced recognition features require the Full edition.

notes.zh:
- **测量与标注更灵活**：新增角度测量，距离标注可按校准后的数值修改；文字支持粗体、斜体，标注颜色预设可自定义，水印内容可跨截图保留。
- **公式与表格识别更方便（完整版）**：LaTeX 识别结果可预览、编辑；表格和公式识别可选择视觉模型。
- **贴图更好用**：可设置贴图阴影，隐藏、恢复贴图窗口，改善窗口大小与内容的匹配。
- **截图更流畅、更省内存**：改善选区拖动与显示的流畅度，空闲时减少内存占用；再次截图时，光标显示更稳定。
- **日常操作更稳定**：改善序号文字样式、设置修改、长菜单和弹窗关闭，修复更新下载进度显示。
notes.en:
- **More flexible measurement and annotation:** measure angles, edit distances by their calibrated value, use bold and italic text, customize color presets, and remember watermark text across captures.
- **Easier formula and table recognition (Full edition):** preview and edit recognized LaTeX formulas, and choose a vision model for table and formula recognition.
- **Better pinned images:** customize shadows, hide and restore pinned windows, and get improved sizing around their content.
- **Smoother capture, lower idle memory use:** smoother selection dragging and display, less memory use while idle, and more consistent cursor display when taking another screenshot.
- **Everyday reliability:** improved numbered text styles, settings edits, long menus, popup dismissal, and update download progress.

notes.zh:
- **新增距离测量工具**：在截图上标注距离，支持像素校准、单位、精度和端点样式设置。
- **截图保存更快捷**：新增“另存为”和“快速保存”全局快捷键，可开启截图开始时的快门音；改善恢复上次选区后的确认和鼠标滚轮智能选择。
- **标注更顺手**：文本可按可见范围自动换行，序号关联文字保留默认字号，框选也能选中点和水平、垂直线条。
- **贴图更稳定**：改善多显示器上的贴图定位与窗口大小同步，贴图分组切换窗口采用原生窗口边框。
- **macOS 原生通知**：通过系统通知中心接收应用通知。
- **日常使用更可靠**：减少 Windows 截图、录屏卡住的问题；打印预览失败时自动尝试传统打印对话框，改善旧版本覆盖安装后的更新功能。
notes.en:
- **Distance measurement:** annotate lengths on screenshots with pixel calibration, units, decimal precision, and endpoint styles.
- **Faster saving:** new global shortcuts for Save as file and Quick save, plus an optional shutter sound when capture starts. Restored selections and smart selection with the mouse wheel work more reliably.
- **Easier annotation:** text wraps within the visible area, numbered labels retain your default text size, and marquee selection includes dots and horizontal or vertical strokes.
- **More stable pinned images:** improved placement and size synchronization across monitors, with native window borders for the group switcher.
- **Native macOS notifications:** receive app notifications through Notification Center.
- **Everyday reliability:** fewer Windows capture and recording hangs; printing falls back to the classic dialog if modern preview fails. Upgrading an older installation also restores updater support.

notes.zh:
- **截图操作更快捷**：截图时按 Ctrl+A（macOS 为 ⌘A）选中当前屏幕；序号标注在每次新截图时从头编号。
- **减少重复确认**：关闭、销毁贴图或通过快捷键退出截图时，可分别选择“不再询问”。
- **识别与标注更顺手**：OCR 原图预览支持拖动查看，箭头大小调整更精细，工具分组的首个按钮始终可见；Snow Shot 在调整截图选区时保留翻译模式。
- **录屏更省心**：可在视频导出成功后自动退出截图，并显示完成通知；点击通知可定位导出文件。
- **大图处理更流畅**：改善图片导出、长截图和菜单响应速度，减少重复处理和内存占用。
- **修复日常问题**：改善录屏启动失败后的恢复及备用捕获方式，再次点击当前绘图工具可回到选择工具；修复贴图打印后的工具栏状态、Windows ARM64 卡住和部分 WebP 图片处理问题。
notes.en:
- **Quicker screenshots:** press Ctrl+A (⌘A on macOS) to select the current screen. Numbered annotations restart with each new screenshot.
- **Fewer repeated prompts:** remember your confirmation choice separately for closing or destroying pinned images and exiting screenshots with a shortcut.
- **Easier recognition and annotation:** drag the OCR original-image preview to inspect it and adjust smaller arrowheads. The first button in each tool group stays visible. Snow Shot also keeps translation mode when resizing a capture selection.
- **More convenient recording:** optionally exit the capture after a successful video export and show a completion notification. Click the notification to reveal the saved file.
- **Smoother large-image work:** faster image exports, scrolling capture, and menus, with less repeated processing and memory use.
- **Everyday fixes:** more reliable recording startup and capture fallbacks; click the active drawing tool again to return to selection. Fixed pinned-image toolbar state after printing, Windows ARM64 hangs, and some WebP image handling.

notes.zh:
- **工具栏按需定制**：自由选择并排列截图、贴图和录屏工具栏中的操作，编辑选区时也可保留常用工具栏。
- **贴图批量操作**：多选贴图后一起移动、调整大小或关闭；可锁定贴图，并设置关闭、销毁时是否确认。
- **分享与打印更方便**：上传截图或贴图到自己的 S3 兼容存储并复制链接，或直接使用系统打印对话框。
- **标注更顺手**：右键快速选择标注；荧光笔按住 Shift 可按 15° 角度绘制，聚光灯可选择镂空形状。改善序号标注的尺寸和连续编号。
- **使用更稳定**：修复工具快捷键、长截图设置变更后的重新捕获、macOS 浮动工具栏拖放和 HEIF/AVIF 图片处理；录屏会排除工具栏弹窗，Windows 更新更好地处理正在使用的文件。
- **新增平台安装包**：两款应用提供 Windows ARM64 版；Snow Shot 新增 Intel Mac 版。macOS Mini 仍仅支持 Apple 芯片。
notes.en:
- **Make toolbars your own:** choose and arrange actions for screenshots, pinned images, and recordings. Keep your preferred toolbar available while editing selections.
- **Manage pinned images together:** select multiple windows to move, resize, or close them together. Lock pinned images and choose whether closing or destroying them asks for confirmation.
- **Share and print:** upload screenshots or pinned images to your own S3-compatible storage and copy the link, or print through the system dialog.
- **Easier annotation:** quickly select annotations with the right mouse button, hold Shift to draw highlighter strokes at 15° angles, and choose spotlight cutout shapes. Numbered annotations have more consistent sizing and numbering.
- **Everyday fixes:** improved shortcuts, scrolling capture after settings changes, macOS floating-toolbar drops, and HEIF/AVIF image handling. Recordings exclude toolbar popups, and Windows updates handle files that are still in use more reliably.
- **More platforms:** both editions now offer Windows ARM64 packages. Snow Shot adds Intel Mac packages; Mini on macOS remains Apple Silicon only.

notes.zh:
- **设置更好找**：按功能整理设置，相关选项可直接跳转，侧边栏随时可搜索；支持调整应用字体大小。
- **文字识别更灵活**：可选择“精度优先”或“速度优先”，并通过智能排版设置按文字布局整理识别结果。
- **翻译更省操作（Snow Shot）**：设置主要和次要目标语言，主要语言的文本译为次要语言，其他文本译为主要语言。
- **长截图更方便**：新增滚动截图设置对话框，可集中调整捕获选项。
- **Windows 更新更清楚**：显示更新进度，可在下次启动时安装已下载的更新。
- **日常使用更流畅**：减少大图的内存开销，改善设置、历史记录和贴图操作；修复撤销/重做快捷键、删除标注后的序号同步，以及工具栏弹窗与取色器相互干扰的问题。

两款应用均提供 Windows x64 和 macOS 15+ Apple Silicon 安装包。Mini 包含适用的截图、OCR、设置与性能改进；翻译功能仅适用于 Snow Shot。
notes.en:
- **Easier settings:** preferences are grouped by feature, related settings link to each other, and search is always available in the sidebar. Adjust the application's font size for more comfortable reading.
- **Better text recognition:** choose Accuracy First or Speed First, and use Smart Typesetting to organize recognized text according to its layout.
- **More convenient translation (Snow Shot):** set primary and secondary target languages. Text already in your primary language translates into the secondary language; other text translates into the primary language.
- **Scrolling screenshots:** open a dedicated settings dialog to adjust scrolling capture options.
- **Clearer Windows updates:** see update progress and apply downloaded updates on the next launch.
- **Smoother everyday use:** reduced memory overhead for large images and faster settings, history, and pinned-window operations. Fixed undo/redo shortcut handling, serial-number synchronization after deleting annotations, and color-picker interference with toolbar popups.

Available for Windows x64 and Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. Snow Shot Mini includes the applicable screenshot, OCR, settings, and performance improvements; translation remains a Snow Shot feature.

notes.zh:
- **录屏剪辑**：录制后预览视频、选择保留片段，再复制或保存剪辑；Windows 还可选择 DXGI、WGC 或 GDI 录屏接口。
- **截图更顺手**：新增可自定义的桌面悬浮工具栏，可调整工具顺序、分组、隐藏和透明度；宽高比吸附快捷键现在可以自定义。
- **文字与标注**：OCR 新增“智能排版”，按识别布局整理文字；序号标注支持更多格式，并保留混合选择中的不同样式。
- **界面与稳定性**：过多的标签页可以滚动查看，溢出菜单更易使用；修复 macOS 截图复制到剪贴板后的兼容性问题，并改善空间不足时的加载提示。
notes.en:
- **Trim recordings:** preview a recording, select the part to keep, then copy or save the clip. On Windows, choose the DXGI, WGC, or GDI screen recording API.
- **Faster capture access:** customize a desktop floating toolbar by reordering, grouping, or hiding tools and setting its opacity. The aspect-ratio snap shortcut is now configurable.
- **Clearer text and annotations:** Smart Typesetting arranges recognized text using its detected layout. Serial-number annotations gain more formats and retain distinct styles in mixed selections.
- **Polish and fixes:** scroll through crowded tabs and use an improved overflow menu. macOS image clipboard compatibility and loading notices in tight spaces are improved.


[Full changelog since 1.2.0](https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/compare/v1.2.0_snow-shot...v1.2.1_snow-shot)

notes.zh:
- **擦除更灵活**：新增矩形和画笔背景擦除，恢复截图原始像素；擦除工具中可直接清空画布。
- **选区更精准**：保存常用宽高比，按 Ctrl 吸附宽高比或切换元素吸附；新增可配置对齐辅助线，并可直接拖动调整选区圆角和阴影。
- **截图光标随时切换**：无需重新截图即可显示或隐藏光标，历史记录和导出保留所选状态。
- **个性化外观与导出**：为主窗口、工具栏和托盘菜单设置图片皮肤；导出配置时可选择包含绘图样式，默认不包含。
- **识别与贴图更方便**：识别和翻译结果旁可显示原图；贴图按钮显示可配置，拖出图片保存更可靠。macOS Mini 按需下载识别模型，下载后可离线复用。
- **录屏与体验改进**：录屏区域控件操作更准确，保存处理期间可关闭录屏窗口；改进设置滑块、阴影控件、绘制流畅度和稳定性，缩小安装包，并在静默升级后重新启动应用。
notes.en:
- **More flexible erasing:** rectangle and brush background erasers restore the original screenshot pixels. Clear the canvas directly from the eraser controls.
- **More precise selections:** save aspect-ratio presets, use Ctrl for ratio snapping or to toggle element snapping, configure alignment guides, and drag selection handles to adjust corners and shadows.
- **Toggle captured cursors:** show or hide the cursor without taking another screenshot; history and exports retain your choice.
- **Personalize and share settings:** use image skins for the main window, toolbars, and tray menus. Choose whether configuration exports include drawing styles; they are excluded by default.
- **Recognition and pins:** view the original image beside recognition and translation results, configure pinned-window button visibility, and drag images out more reliably. macOS Mini downloads OCR models on demand and reuses them offline.
- **Recording and reliability:** interact more reliably with recording-region controls and close the recording window during finalization. Enjoy smoother drawing, improved settings sliders and shadow controls, smaller packages, stability fixes, and automatic relaunch after silent upgrades.


[Full changelog since 1.1.9](https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/compare/v1.1.9_snow-shot...v1.2.0_snow-shot)

notes.zh:
- **新增 Snow Shot Mini**：提供独立的精简版，保留截图、标注、贴图、录屏和手动文字识别；不包含翻译、二维码、表格、公式识别及图像转 Markdown/HTML 等功能。文字识别入口默认隐藏，可在设置中开启；Windows 首次识别时按需下载 OCR 资源。完整版与 Mini 的设置和更新相互独立。
- **录屏声音更好控制**：麦克风和系统声音可分别调节增益，实时音量指示帮助检查声音大小、削波和音源状态。
- **录屏后期处理**：支持先录制、再处理效果，显示处理进度，并可取消、重试或保留源文件；新增进度条与播放时间叠加效果。录屏工具栏可直接打开录屏设置。
- **长截图更方便查看**：悬停缩略图可预览对应区域，改进颜色还原；优化 HDR 截图的颜色转换、性能及取色准确性。
- **贴图与文字操作**：重新固定剪贴板截图时保留外观和位置；新增置顶、边框切换快捷键；双击识别出的文字块即可复制。修复贴图缩放滤镜和画布文字编辑问题。
- **macOS 与稳定性**：新增应用调度优先级设置；修复窗口截图阴影、放大镜动画和目标窗口选择问题。减少截图、录屏、历史记录和编辑窗口关闭后的资源占用，并改善 GIF 对比度与纹理填充显示。
notes.en:
- **Snow Shot Mini:** a separate, streamlined edition for screenshots, annotations, pins, recording, and manual text recognition. Translation, QR, table and formula recognition, and image-to-Markdown/HTML conversion are omitted. Enable the initially hidden text-recognition action in settings; Windows downloads OCR resources on first use. Mini keeps its own settings and updates.
- **Recording audio:** adjust microphone and system-audio gain independently, with live meters showing levels, clipping, and source status.
- **Recording post-processing:** capture first and process effects afterward, with progress, cancellation, retry, and an option to retain the source. Add progress-bar and playback-time overlays, and open recording preferences directly from the toolbar.
- **Scrolling and HDR capture:** hover over scrolling-capture thumbnails to preview the corresponding region. Improve color restoration, HDR conversion performance, and color-picking accuracy.
- **Pins and recognized text:** preserve screenshot appearance and placement when pinning clipboard content again; configure always-on-top and border shortcuts; double-click a recognized text block to copy it. Fix scaled filters and canvas text editing.
- **macOS and reliability:** configure application scheduling priority; fix window-capture shadows, magnifier animations, and target-window selection. Release resources more promptly after capture, recording, history browsing, and editing; improve GIF contrast and patterned fills.


[Full changelog since 1.1.8](https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/compare/v1.1.8_snow-shot...v1.1.9_snow-shot)

notes.zh:
## 新功能与改进

- **贴图操作**：按住 Ctrl 拖动贴图即可导出截图；贴图工具栏的导出操作支持自定义。重复固定剪贴板内容或同一文件时，可选择忽略、摇动已有窗口、恢复上次关闭的窗口或重复执行固定操作。新增可配置的窗口组切换快捷键与预览选择器，并配备独立设置图标。复制的截图携带显示器与图像尺寸信息，重新固定剪贴板截图时可恢复原来的位置和大小，并处理显示器布局变化。
- **图像预览**：截图历史与贴图窗口共用连续图像查看器，支持在筛选后的图片之间导航，并跨越历史分页。
- **录屏与导出**：新增 MP4 视频质量控制，可调整画质与文件大小；改进 GIF 自适应调色板、缩放与编码。可选择将扬声器和麦克风声音保存为独立 MP4 音轨，方便后期分别处理，并支持自动化录制参数覆盖。此功能为可选设置；多数播放器一次播放一条音轨。
- **OCR 文本**：新增默认格式与标点设置，在编辑或复制识别结果时，自动保留或去除换行，并选择半角或全角标点。
- **设置与托盘**：Windows 支持选择并迁移应用数据目录，复制过程会校验文件，并协调正在使用存储的组件。设置搜索结果使用分类标签，改善说明文字的显示宽度。禁用全局快捷键时，托盘图标显示状态标记；可自定义加入贴图管理和全屏画布入口，这两个入口默认隐藏。

## Features and improvements

- **Pinned screenshots:** export by Ctrl-dragging a pin and customize its export actions. Choose how duplicate clipboard/file pin requests behave: ignore, shake the existing window, restore the last closed window, or repeat the action. A configurable window-group shortcut opens a preview picker. Screenshot clipboard metadata restores a pin's original placement and size while accounting for changed display layouts.
- **Image browsing:** navigate continuously through filtered screenshot-history images and pinned images, including across history page boundaries.
- **Recording:** adjust MP4 quality and file size, and use improved adaptive GIF palette generation and output scaling. Optionally record speaker and microphone audio as separate, labeled MP4 tracks for independent editing; automation can override this per recording. Most players play one audio track at a time.
- **OCR:** set default recognized-text formatting and punctuation conversion for editing and copying. Preserve/remove line breaks and select half-width/full-width punctuation.
- **Settings and tray:** select and migrate the application data directory on Windows, with copied-file verification and coordination of active storage users. Search results gain category tags and improved description layout. A tray badge indicates disabled global shortcuts. Optional tray actions open pin management and the full-screen canvas; both are hidden by default.
- **Distribution:** published releases are mirrored to Gitee. Update discovery and downloads support GitHub/Gitee fallback while retaining package verification. Scoop support installs the portable package with default OCR resources.

## Fixes

- Preserve active canvas text drafts when Escape is pressed.
- Prevent macOS modal dialogs from reactivating during dismissal and restore recording-border drag input.
- Preserve bundled macOS tray-icon colors and center the disabled-shortcuts badge.
- Correct native macOS microphone binding and search-category color indexing.
- Align recorded macOS cursor orientation, hotspot placement, and trail behavior with the preview.
- Manage clipboard publication lifetimes across platforms, add macOS image conversion, and release export snapshots promptly.
- Keep reused macOS screenshot overlays free of presentation animations.

前几天有用户反馈软件报毒问题，这里做了个扫描报告，单独做个软件只为了植入病毒……成本过高，应该没人会这样做吧……

#### 扫描文件：

文件名：Snow.Shot_0.2.0-beta-20250809-02_windows.exe 
SHA256：41C1B740319FD11D324919F6FCBB150A7189DB13ACED8B9F61830AE0BFC63686

之前的版本扫描的话结果应该是类似的。比较敏感的功能可能是截图时的鼠标控制、固定到屏幕窗口的鼠标监听、Mac OS 部分功能下的键盘监听（特殊键的点击事件如 Shift、Command 需要使用系统 API 进行监听）、使用命令行实现视频录制相关功能。

[VirsSan 分析报告](https://www.virscan.org/report/41c1b740319fd11d324919f6fcbb150a7189db13aced8b9f61830ae0bfc63686)
[Kaspersky 分析报告](https://opentip.kaspersky.com/41C1B740319FD11D324919F6FCBB150A7189DB13ACED8B9F61830AE0BFC63686/results?tab=upload)

VirsSan 中有一个引擎报毒了：F-Prot 报了 W32/Felix:EX:007!Eldorado，我查了下应该是旧的扫描引擎误报。
Kaspersky 扫描是安全的，但提示了 3 个高风险的可疑活动，我点击详情加载不出来，没法解释了……

Snow Shot 携带病毒木马的可能来源是 Snow Shot 引用了其他开源的软件，被引用的软件被其作者植入病毒了。这点目前看是安全的。
